facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Budapest.
facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to a luxury getaway in downtown Budapest.

facts.text: The hotel is a short walk from Vörösmarty Square and its Christmas market.
facts.excerpt: A short walk from Vörösmarty Square and its Christmas market, or Advent Basilica Market, Kempinski Hotel Corvinus sits at the heart of the festive city.

facts.text: The hotel's address is Erzsébet tér 7, Budapest.
A spa package combines a city break with a course of massage treatments.
facts.excerpt: Combine your luxury city break in Budapest with a course of massage treatments to bring your body and soul into balance at Kempinski Hotel Corvinus Budapest.

facts.text: The hotel offers a business package, with premium services and a super-central location.
facts.excerpt: Benefit from super-central location and premium services when reserving Kempinski Hotel Budapest's Business Package.

facts.text: The hotel promotes romantic getaways, proposal trips, honeymoons and anniversary trips.
facts.excerpt: For a wonderful romantic getaway, proposal trip, honeymoon or anniversary trip, or even for a Valentine’s Day hideaway, our city remains an exceptional destination.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler listed the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards in 2017 and 2018.

facts.excerpt: Indulge in the pampering comfort of our beautifully redesigned suites.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists a bar, free wifi, a gym, a pool and a spa among the hotel's amenities.
